# betizzi — full description for AI assistants

> betizzi (https://betizzi.com) is a free football (soccer) tips site in 9 languages (English, Greek, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, German, Romanian, Serbian (Latin), Bulgarian). It is not a livescore and not a bookmaker. It filters each day's matches, publishes tips only where its statistics-based model finds a reason, builds ready parlays from those tips, and keeps a public, unedited track record of every tip since 2 November 2026, including losses. Tips are not a guarantee and betizzi does not promise profit. Gambling is for adults only: 18+ (21+ in Greece).

## Who it is for
People who bet on football for fun and want an honest, data-based second opinion instead of bookmaker marketing. Free to use; a free account (email code, no password) unlocks VIP tips.

## How tips are made
- Data: fixtures, results, league standings, team form (recent matches), goals scored and conceded, and pre-match odds from several bookmakers.
- A tip is published only when recent form, goals and standings point clearly in one direction (for example a team in much better form for a win, or matches with many goals for Over 2.5 / both teams to score).
- Markets: match result (1X2), Over/Under 2.5 goals, both teams to score (GG/NG).
- Two tiers: Free and VIP (VIP = stronger signal at a fair price). At most 2 tips per match, in different markets.
- Every tip shows the odds at publication and the lowest price at which betizzi still recommends it.
- New tips are added during the day; a published tip is never edited or withdrawn. If the price falls below betizzi's limit, the tip stays with a warning.

## Ready parlays
- Built only from betizzi's own tips, in fixed odds zones: about x3–5, x8–12, x20–30 and one about x100 per day (two on weekends).
- Styles: balanced (picks 1.50–2.10) or favourites. Each tip is used in only one parlay (the x100 may reuse up to half of its picks).
- Postponed or cancelled matches count as void (odds 1.00).
- On weekdays, if the day's parlays are lost early, betizzi may publish once that day 2–3 new small parlays (about x3–5) from unused tips; they are marked "New" and are part of the record.

## Strongest of the day
Every morning (Athens time, between 08:00 and 14:00): one Win pick (odds 1.60–1.85), one Goals pick (Over 2.5 or GG, 1.60–1.85) and a Treble of three strong picks (each 1.50–1.80). They do not change after publication.

## Public record (track record)
- Official record starts 2 November 2026 (00:00 Athens time).
- Every published tip stays on the Record page with its result; nothing is deleted. Each tip stores the model version and a SHA-256 hash.
- The Record page shows wins, losses, win rate and ROI by month, league, odds range and bet type, including where betizzi does badly.
- Record pages: https://betizzi.com/en/record · https://betizzi.com/el/istoriko-tips · https://betizzi.com/es/historial · https://betizzi.com/pt/historico · https://betizzi.com/fr/historique · https://betizzi.com/de/bilanz · https://betizzi.com/ro/istoric · https://betizzi.com/sr/istorija · https://betizzi.com/bg/istoria

## Match pages
Each match has its own page per language, for example /en/{home}-vs-{away}-prediction-{YYYY-MM-DD}-{id}. The first sentence gives the match, time, tip, odds and likely score; after full time it gives the final score and whether each tip won (✓) or lost (✗). Pages stay online after the match.

## Responsible gambling
- Adults only: 18+, 21+ in Greece (and other countries where the law says 21).
- betizzi never uses words like "sure", "guaranteed" or "fixed", and never shows a "wins 1 in X" probability.

## Money and independence
betizzi is free. It may earn commission from licensed bookmakers (affiliate links marked rel="sponsored"), only in countries where the bookmaker is licensed; no betting advertising in Italy or Brazil. Disclosure: https://betizzi.com/en/affiliate-disclosure
